name: RMBG 3.0
description: Bria's RMBG 3.0 removes the background from an image and returns a PNG cutout with a transparent background, with cleaner edges than RMBG 2.0 on hair, fur, glass, smoke and other fine or see-through detail. In Bria's blind test on 234 hard images it gave the best or tied-best cutout on 185, more than Photoroom, remove.bg, Ideogram, BiRefNet or RMBG 2.0. It is trained only on licensed data and takes a few seconds per image; for speed and high volume use bria/remove-background (RMBG 2.0).

image.description: JPEG, PNG, or WEBP image, a public URL or base64-encoded image data (a `data:` URI prefix is accepted).

preserve_alpha.description: Keep partial transparency from the input alpha channel. When false, every foreground pixel is fully opaque. Default true.

visual_input_content_moderation.description: Reject the request if the input image fails content moderation. Default false.

visual_output_content_moderation.description: Fail the request if the result fails content moderation. Default false.

image.description: URL of the PNG cutout with a transparent background. Bria hosts it for a limited time (3 days by default); download it to keep it.
